Mercurius  Soluhilis  et  Vivus.     The  Black  Oxide  and  the  Element.

Mercurius  solubilis  was  introduced  by  Hahnemann  and  proved  upon  himself,
Gross,  Gutmann,  Fr.  Hahnemann,  Hartmann,  Hornburg,  Langhammer,  Eummel
and  Stapf  (Mat.  Med.  Pura),  also  in  a  fragmentary  way  by  Knorre  (Allg.  Horn.

by  Berridge  (Med.  Inv.,  N.  S.,  vol.  1,  p.  101).

The  symptoms  of  the  solubilis,  obtained  by  regular  proving,  and  the  effects  of
the  vivus,  gathered  from  toxicological  reports  carefully  sifted  and  clinically  verified,
are  sufficiently  simular  to  be  placed  under  one  arrangement.  Virtually  the  action
of  the  two  remedies  appears  to  be  the  same,  and  they  have  not  always  been  dis-
